# Backend ↔ frontend events

Events emitted with `emit` / `emit_to` and listened to with `listen` / `once`. Payload types are in the emitting Rust file (search the event name).

| Event | Emitted by (Rust) | Listened to by (JS) |
|---|---|---|
| `load` | — | map-view.js |
| `scan-detail` | main.rs | main.js |
| `scan-progress` | face_detect.rs, face_models.rs, geolocation.rs, keywords.rs, main.rs, private_maps.rs, semantic.rs, semantic_models.rs, update_check.rs | main.js |
